paper.title: Punctuated equilibrium and criticality in a simple model of evolution

headline: Bak-Sneppen 1993 (extremal dynamics / SOC, disclosed not agent-stepping): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; stationary cutoff f_c=0.648 (canonical ~0.667), avalanches span 5.0 decades, 193 punctuating dips below f_c

verdicts.gate: P1 stationary lower cutoff f_c in [0.60, 0.72] (SOC threshold ~0.667)
P3 punctuated equilibrium (running min repeatedly dips below + recovers above f_c)

extra.framing: extremal dynamics / SOC; model-orchestrated global-min selection, NOT autonomous-agent-stepping (disclosed)
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic SOC model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the SOC threshold + power-law avalanches and would catch an artifact

citations: Bak, P. & Sneppen, K. (1993). Punctuated equilibrium and criticality in a simple model of evolution. Phys. Rev. Lett. 71(24):4083-4086. doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.71.4083.

Paczuski, M., Maslov, S. & Bak, P. (1996). Avalanche dynamics in evolution, growth, and depinning models. Phys. Rev. E 53:414-443. doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.53.414 (the f0-avalanche definition used here; f_c ~ 0.6670 for the 1D nearest-neighbour model).

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction. Literature anchors: stationary fitnesses ~uniform on (f_c, 1) with f_c ~ 0.667, power-law f0-avalanches, punctuated intermittent activity (Bak & Sneppen 1993; Paczuski-Maslov-Bak 1996).
